name: framefr
description: FrameFR — seguimiento de tráfico aéreo en tiempo real sobre un mapa interactivo (React + TypeScript + Vite + MapLibre GL)

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs && node scripts/check-worker.mjs
scripts.smoke: vite build --config smoke.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-smoke/smoke.js
scripts.check:render: vite build --config scripts/render.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-render/render-check.js
scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run check:render
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
